models.description: Strong pick for careful English and German writing, translation, and proofreading: strong instruction following and long-form consistency. Expect ~10 GB on disk and higher RAM use than 7B options—use Qwen 7B or Mistral 7B if your machine is tighter.
models.license_note: Apache-2.0 — Qwen2.5; see Alibaba model card on Hugging Face.

models.description: Strong mid-size instruct model with clear, safe answers and solid EN/DE quality—good when Qwen 14B is too heavy. A notch below the 14B pick on the hardest mixed-language or very long passages.
models.license_note: Gemma license — see Google Gemma terms on Hugging Face model card.

models.description: Efficient 7B instruct with strong multilingual behavior and disciplined replies—suitable for everyday correction and translation when you want lower latency and ~5 GB downloads than the 14B flagship.
models.license_note: Apache-2.0 — Qwen2.5; see Alibaba model card on Hugging Face.

models.description: Recommended starting model: widely used 7B instruct checkpoint with crisp answers and reliable EN/DE for drafting and translation-style prompts. A practical lighter alternative to Qwen 7B depending on taste; all picks here are 7B+ so Maguna does not steer you toward toy-sized models.
models.license_note: Apache-2.0 — see Mistral model card on Hugging Face.

models.description: Open-weight reasoning-style model distilled from DeepSeek-R1 into the Qwen-7B architecture: strong math, logic, and step-by-step answers. Replies often include a visible chain-of-thought style trace before the final answer—great for analysis, awkward for polished prose; prefer Mistral or Qwen 2.5 Instruct when you want clean copy.
models.license_note: MIT — DeepSeek R1 distill; base Qwen license applies; see Hugging Face model cards.
